name: Vruddhi Engineering Works Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2020, Vruddhi Engineering 
Works Ltd provides mechanical splicing solutions to the real estate, construction, and infrastructure industry[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
VEWL is in trading of couplers, threading services and crimping services for couplers, trading, importing and exporting of engineered construction products, MS products and construction machinery and spares. It design and engineer the rebar couplers as per customer's requirement and manufactured by a third-party manufacturer.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 30.9%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 35.8 days to 63.5 days
